      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="AccountSource" type="AccountSourceType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='AccountSource']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Account source">
          <xsd:documentation>The source of the account record, for example Advertisement, Data.com, or Trade Show.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="AnnualRevenue" type="xsd:double">
        <xsd:annotation format="double" optional="true" title="Annual revenue">

        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="BillingStreet" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Billing street">
          <xsd:documentation>The street address for the billing address of this account</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ShippingState" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Shipping state or province">
          <xsd:documentation>The state or province of the shipping address for this account. Maximum length is 80 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="BillingCountry" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Billing country">
          <xsd:documentation>The country for the billing address of this account. Maximum length is 80 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="DandbCompanyId" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="D&B Company ID">
          <xsd:documentation>D&B Company ID</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="LastViewedDate" type="xsd:time">
        <xsd:annotation format="date-time" optional="true" title="Last-viewed date">
          <xsd:documentation>The timestamp for when the current user last viewed this record</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="MasterRecordId" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Primary record ID">
          <xsd:documentation>The ID of the record that was kept if the account was deleted as the result of a merge. If the account was deleted for another reason, or hasn’t been deleted, the primary record ID is null.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ShippingStreet" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Shipping street">
          <xsd:documentation>The street address of the shipping address for this account. Maximum length is 255 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="SystemModstamp" type="xsd:time">
        <xsd:annotation format="date-time" optional="true" title="System modstamp">
          <xsd:documentation>System modstamp</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="BillingLatitude" type="xsd:double">
        <xsd:annotation format="double" optional="true" title="Billing latitude">
          <xsd:documentation>Used with billing longitude to specify the precise geolocation of a billing address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="JigsawCompanyId" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Jigsaw company ID">
          <xsd:documentation>The Jigsaw company ID</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ShippingCountry" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Shipping country">
          <xsd:documentation>The country of the shipping address for this account. Maximum length is 80 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="BillingLongitude" type="xsd:double">
        <xsd:annotation format="double" optional="true" title="Billing longitude">
          <xsd:documentation>Used with billing latitude to specify the precise geolocation of a billing address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="LastActivityDate" type="xsd:date">
        <xsd:annotation format="date" optional="true" title="Last activity">
          <xsd:documentation>Due date of the most recent event logged against the record or the due date of the most recently closed task associated with the record, whichever is the most recent date</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="LastModifiedById" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Last-modified ID">
          <xsd:documentation>The ID of the user who last modified the account</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="LastModifiedDate" type="xsd:time">
        <xsd:annotation format="date-time" optional="true" title="Last-modified date">
          <xsd:documentation>The date when the account was last modified</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="OperatingHoursId" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Operating Hour ID">
          <xsd:documentation>Operating Hour ID</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ShippingLatitude" type="xsd:double">
        <xsd:annotation format="double" optional="true" title="Shipping latitude">
          <xsd:documentation>Used with shipping longitude to specify the precise geolocation of a shipping address. Acceptable values are numbers between –90 and 90 with up to 15 decimal places.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="BillingPostalCode" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Billing zip or postal code">
          <xsd:documentation>The zip or postal code for the billing address of this account. Maximum length is 20 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="NumberOfEmployees" type="xsd:double">
        <xsd:annotation format="double" optional="true" title="Employees">
          <xsd:documentation>Number of employees working at the company represented by this account. Maximum length is 8 digits. '</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ShippingLongitude" type="xsd:double">
        <xsd:annotation format="double" optional="true" title="Shipping longitude">
          <xsd:documentation>Used with shipping latitude to specify the precise geolocation of an address. Acceptable values are numbers between –180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="LastReferencedDate" type="xsd:time">
        <xsd:annotation format="date-time" optional="true" title="Last-referenced date">
          <xsd:documentation>The timestamp for when the current user last viewed a record related to this record.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="SLASerialNumber__c" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="SLA Serial Number">
          <xsd:documentation>SLA Serial Number</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ShippingPostalCode" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Shipping zip or postal Code">
          <xsd:documentation>The zip or post code of the shipping address for this account. Maximum length is 20 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="CustomerPriority__c" type="CustomerPriority__cType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='CustomerPriority__c']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Customer Priority">
          <xsd:documentation>Customer Priority</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="NumberofLocations__c" type="xsd:double">
        <xsd:annotation format="double" optional="true" title="Number of Locations">
          <xsd:documentation>Number of Locations</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="SLAExpirationDate__c" type="xsd:date">
        <xsd:annotation format="date" optional="true" title="SLA Expiration Date">
          <xsd:documentation>SLA Expiration Date</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="UpsellOpportunity__c" type="UpsellOpportunity__cType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='UpsellOpportunity__c']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Upsell Opportunity">
          <xsd:documentation>Upsell Opportunity</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="BillingGeocodeAccuracy" type="BillingGeocodeAccuracyType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='BillingGeocodeAccuracy']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Billing geocode accuracy">
          <xsd:documentation>Billing geocode accuracy</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ShippingGeocodeAccuracy" type="BillingGeocodeAccuracyType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='ShippingGeocodeAccuracy']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Shipping geocode accuracy">
          <xsd:documentation>Shipping geocode accuracy</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:simpleType name="TypeType">
    <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string">
      <xsd:enumeration value="Prospect"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Customer - Direct"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Customer - Channel"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Channel Partner / Reseller"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Installation Partner"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Technology Partner"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Other"/>
    </xsd:restriction>
  </xsd:simpleType>
  <xsd:simpleType name="RatingType">
    <xsd:restriction base="xsd:string">
      <xsd:enumeration value="Gold"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Silver"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Bronze"/>

      <xsd:enumeration value="Machinery"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Manufacturing"/>
      <xsd:enumeration value="Media"/>

  <xsd:simpleType name="OwnershipType">

    <xsd:sequence>

  <xsd:simpleType name="CleanStatusType">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><xsd:schema xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/3731d10a-bce7-4e3c-99ce-15b56e1ab8a1.xsd" xmlns:ibmbpm="http://lombardi.ibm.com/schema/" targetNamespace="http://www.ibm.com/xmlns/prod/bpm/bpmn/ext/externalservice/swagger/xsd/3731d10a-bce7-4e3c-99ce-15b56e1ab8a1.xsd">
  <xsd:element name="retrievewithwhere_AccountRequest" type="retrievewithwhere_AccountRequest"/>
  <xsd:element name="retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse" type="retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse"/>
  <xsd:complexType name="retrievewithwhere_AccountRequest">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="next_page_token" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true">
          <xsd:documentation>token to obtain next set of records</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="filter" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true">
          <xsd:documentation>The [`filter`](https://loopback.io/doc/en/lb4/Where-filter.html) is a type of filter clause that consists of one or more logical conditions to match, it is a way of achieving subsetting of data based on the specified conditions</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="next" type="nextType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='next']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true"/>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0" name="instances" type="instancesType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true"/>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="nextType">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="next_page_token" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true">
          <xsd:documentation>For token-based pagination, the token to retrieve the next page</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
    </xsd:sequence>
  </xsd:complexType>
  <xsd:complexType name="instancesType">
    <xsd:sequence>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Id" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Account ID">
          <xsd:documentation>The system-generated ID assigned when the account is created</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Fax" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Account fax">
          <xsd:documentation>The fax number for the account. Maximum length is 40 digits.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Sic" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="SIC Code">
          <xsd:documentation>SIC Code</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Name" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Account name">
          <xsd:documentation>Name of the account. A name can’t be longer than 255 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Site" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Account site">
          <xsd:documentation>Account site</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Type" type="TypeType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='Type']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Account type">
          <xsd:documentation>The type of account, for example Customer, Competitor, or Partner</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Phone" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Account phone">
          <xsd:documentation>The phone number for this account. Maximum length is 40 digits.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Jigsaw" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Data.com key">
          <xsd:documentation>The company ID in Data.com</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Rating" type="RatingType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='Rating']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Account rating">
          <xsd:documentation>Account rating</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="SLA__c" type="SLA__cType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='SLA__c']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="SLA">
          <xsd:documentation>SLA</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="OwnerId" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Owner ID">
          <xsd:documentation>The unique identifier of the user who currently owns this account</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="SicDesc" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="SIC description">
          <xsd:documentation>A brief description of an organization’s line of business, based on its Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code. Maximum length is 80 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Website" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Website">
          <xsd:documentation>The website of this account. Maximum length is 255 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Industry" type="IndustryType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='Industry']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Industry">
          <xsd:documentation>The industry associated with this account. Maximum length is 40 characters.</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="ParentId" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Parent account ID">
          <xsd:documentation>ID of the parent object</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="PhotoUrl" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Photo URL">
          <xsd:documentation>The URL to request the social network profile image associated with the account</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Active__c" type="Active__cType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='Active__c']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Active">
          <xsd:documentation>Active</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="IsDeleted" type="xsd:boolean">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Deleted">
          <xsd:documentation>Indicates whether the account has been moved to the recycle bin</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="NaicsCode" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="NAICS Code">
          <xsd:documentation>NAICS Code</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="NaicsDesc" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="NAICS Description">
          <xsd:documentation>NAICS Description</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Ownership" type="OwnershipType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='Ownership']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Ownership">
          <xsd:documentation>Ownership</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="DunsNumber" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="D-U-N-S Number">
          <xsd:documentation>D-U-N-S Number</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="Tradestyle" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Tradestyle">
          <xsd:documentation>Tradestyle</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="attributes" type="attributesType" xpathBeforeFlattening="/xsd:schema/xsd:complexType[@name='retrievewithwhere_AccountResponse']/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='instances']/xsd:complexType/xsd:sequence/xsd:element[@name='attributes']">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Attributes">
          <xsd:documentation>Attributes</xsd:documentation>
        </xsd:annotation>
      </xsd:element>
      <xsd:element minOccurs="0" name="BillingCity" type="xsd:string">
        <xsd:annotation optional="true" title="Billing city">
          <xsd:documentation>The city for the billing address of this account. Maximum length is 40 characters.</xsd:documentation>
